```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
# Named players are keyed on the CFBD athlete id (decision 0013 on recruiting ids).
subjects <- running_cast()[c("Kyle Allen", "Shane Buechele")]
recruits <- tbl(con, "recruiting") |>
  filter(playerId %in% !!unname(subjects)) |>
  select(
    playerId,
    recruit_name,
    hs_class,
    committed_to,
    recruit_position,
    stars,
    rating,
    national_rank
  ) |>
  collect()
# Every quarterback recruit in the two players' classes, ranked within each
# class by composite rating, so each profile sits among its peers.
qb_pool <- tbl(con, "recruiting") |>
  filter(
    hs_class %in% !!recruits$hs_class,
    recruit_position %in% c("PRO", "DUAL"),
    !is.na(rating)
  ) |>
  select(recruit_name, hs_class, committed_to, stars, rating, national_rank) |>
  collect() |>
  group_by(hs_class) |>
  mutate(qb_rank = rank(desc(rating), ties.method = "min")) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(named = recruit_name %in% names(subjects))
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: profiles-table
# The two profiles side by side: the recruiting record itself, which the dot
# plot below does not show (star grade, national rank and commitment).
recruits |>
  arrange(desc(stars)) |>
  transmute(
    player = recruit_name,
    hs_class = hs_class,
    committed = committed_to,
    stars = stars,
    rating = sprintf("%.4f", rating),
    national = national_rank,
    qb_rank = vapply(
      recruit_name,
      \(who) qb_pool$qb_rank[qb_pool$recruit_name == who][1],
      numeric(1)
    ),
    qb_n = vapply(
      hs_class,
      \(cl) sum(qb_pool$hs_class == cl),
      integer(1)
    )
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c(
      "Player",
      "High-school class",
      "Committed to",
      "Stars",
      "Composite rating",
      "National rank",
      "Quarterback rank in class",
      "Quarterbacks rated in class"
    ),
    caption = "The two recruiting profiles. A lower rank is better: national rank counts every recruit in the class, quarterback rank only the rated quarterbacks."
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
# Each class's rated quarterback recruits, the two named players in the
# quarterback orange, and the rest pale.
labelled <- qb_pool |>
  filter(named) |>
  mutate(
    label = sprintf(
      "%s\n%d-star, quarterback %d of %d",
      recruit_name,
      stars,
      qb_rank,
      vapply(hs_class, \(cl) sum(qb_pool$hs_class == cl), integer(1))
    )
  )

p <- ggplot(qb_pool, aes(rating, factor(hs_class))) +
  geom_point(
    data = filter(qb_pool, !named),
    position = position_jitter(height = 0.18, width = 0, seed = 1),
    colour = "gray75",
    size = 2
  ) +
  geom_point(data = filter(qb_pool, named), colour = "#D95F02", size = 5) +
  geom_label(
    data = labelled,
    aes(label = label),
    vjust = -0.5,
    hjust = 1,
    size = 4.2,
    lineheight = 0.9,
    fill = "white",
    label.size = 0
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(0.5, 0.9))) +
  expand_limits(x = 1.03) +
  labs(
    title = "Quarterback recruits by rating",
    subtitle = "Gray: other quarterbacks; orange: Allen and Buechele",
    x = "Composite recruiting rating (0 to 1)",
    y = "High-school class",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "allen-buechele-recruiting-rank", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: by-class
# The same ratings split by class, every quarterback recruit hoverable, so a
# reader can see the whole class behind each named player.
p_class <- ggplot(qb_pool, aes(qb_rank, rating)) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      colour = named,
      size = named,
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "%s (%s): %d-star, rating %.4f, quarterback %d in class, national rank %s, committed to %s",
        recruit_name,
        hs_class,
        stars,
        rating,
        qb_rank,
        coalesce(as.character(national_rank), "none"),
        coalesce(committed_to, "unknown")
      ),
      data_id = recruit_name
    )
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~hs_class, labeller = labeller(hs_class = \(x) paste("Class of", x))) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#D95F02", `FALSE` = "gray65")) +
  scale_size_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 4.5, `FALSE` = 1.8)) +
  guides(colour = "none", size = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Every quarterback recruit in the two classes",
    subtitle = "Composite rating by quarterback rank within the class; orange: Allen and Buechele",
    x = "Quarterback rank in class (1 is highest rated)",
    y = "Composite rating",
    caption = "Hover any point for the recruit's name, stars and commitment."
  ) +
  theme_card()
card_interactive(p_class)
```
